title: Z8 runtime detectors
note: Detectors run on every firmware build. They judge the run as it happens and report the problem class with its evidence. A detector without its inputs reports NOT_EXERCISED and never PASS. Calibration runs under calibration/ exist to prove the detectors fire on a known-bad build and stay quiet on a clean one.

detectors.title: every place that carries a count agrees with the extent it describes
no guest access to a poisoned or guarded region
detectors.note: The layout-UB form: an overrun that lands on padding stays silent, an overrun that lands on a live object does not. Poison the landing and the difference becomes visible.

detectors.title: the guard neither allows everything nor skips everything
detectors.note: All-allow and all-skip are both defects of a cross-region bound. A healthy guard lets the valid case through and stops the invalid one.

detectors.title: no crash, diagnostic dump or restart loop in the observed window
twin values that must match each other still match
detectors.note: One value carried by several sources. Raising one source and leaving the others is the drift.

detectors.title: no write past the boundary of a table that is not ours
detectors.note: An unattributed write to the padding or the first record after a table.

detectors.title: the ring stays inside its envelope and delivers frames
detectors.note: A configuration that requests more than the envelope holds degrades the whole ring to zero frames. Zero frames is a failure, not a quiet state.

detectors.title: a state gate says what it decided and does not keep stale state
detectors.note: Sticky card state, dual configuration and fail-closed configuration: every case must end in an explicit verdict, and state that a reset should clear must clear.

detectors.title: the frame count stays within the tier cap
